products.name: Credo AI
products.note: Purpose-built AI governance; policy packs for EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF; clean interface; fast deployment

profile_text.body:
Credo AI is an enterprise software company focused exclusively on AI governance. The company describes itself as having created the AI governance category and positions its platform as purpose-built rather than adapted from existing governance, risk, and compliance tools. Its platform is designed to help organizations discover AI systems in use, enforce policies, manage risk, and demonstrate compliance across models, agents, and applications. A Knowledge Graph that combines regulatory intelligence with customer business context powers the platform, and the company offers forward-deployed experts alongside the software. The platform includes a feature called GAIA, a Govern AI Assistant described as generally available, which the company says can compress weeks of governance work into hours.

The core product, also called Credo AI, supports pre-built policy packs for frameworks including the EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, and ISO 42001, and the company states its team has participated in standards work at ISO, NIST, the EU Parliament, NATO, and the OECD. The platform connects to existing enterprise systems through more than 300 integrations and governs agents as what the company calls first-class entities, meaning each agent can be registered, risk-assessed, and assigned controls appropriate to its specific context. Mastercard and IBM are among the organizations named on the company's site as partners or customers.

Fast Company ranked Credo AI number six in Applied AI on its World's Most Innovative Companies of 2026 list, placing it alongside Google, Nvidia, OpenAI, and Anthropic in that category. The site holds no litigation, MCP server, or SEC filing records for the company at this time.
